output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The increase of balanceOf[target] is not protected by a check, allowing it to overflow and set balanceOf[target] to a very large value, granting arbitrary tokens to the attacker.

The transfer function calls _transfer, which has an integer overflow vulnerability. If balanceOf[_to] is a small value, _value can be large enough to cause overflow in balanceOf[_to] += _value, setting it to a large value and granting arbitrary tokens to the attacker.

The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. If balanceOf[_from] is a small value, _value can be large enough to cause overflow in balanceOf[_from] -= _value, setting it to a large value and granting arbitrary tokens to the attacker.

The mintToken function has a token devalue vulnerability. The increase of totalSupply is not protected by a check, allowing it to overflow and set totalSupply to a very large value, devaluing the token.
The mintToken function has an access control vulnerability. The owner can mint arbitrary amount of tokens to any target address, allowing it to grant arbitrary tokens to any attacker.
